description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - S. P. B. Ekanayaka was selected as Vice Chairman for the Tumpane Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the declaration of a Vice Chairman for a local government authority (Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha) under Section 66g of the Local Government Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes and appointments within local government elections, making it a clear fit for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers "Electoral commission appointments and decisions" and "Candidate nominations and registrations."
